subject.title: Feature: Private Mode for demos and content creation

question: What exact no-read/no-write/no-history guarantee and activation authority should private sessions enforce across core and plugin persistence surfaces?
rationale: A visible Private badge creates a security promise, but the threat model, authorized togglers, restart behavior, and coverage of multiple durable and plugin-owned paths require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Full ephemeral contract
options.body: Make private state session-scoped, authorized, and enforced across workspace context, transcripts, memory, tools, plugins, diagnostics, exports, and channel integrations.

options.title: Context-only demo mode
options.body: Offer a clearly weaker demo mode that suppresses bootstrap context without claiming no persistence or history.

options.title: Decline the guarantee
options.body: Retain current agent-wide context controls and avoid presenting a misleading private-session mode.

recommendation.title: Full ephemeral contract
recommendation.body: Make private state session-scoped, authorized, and enforced across workspace context, transcripts, memory, tools, plugins, diagnostics, exports, and channel integrations.
